title: pleurothallis corniculata
intro: Pleurothallis corniculata, commonly known as the Horned Pleurothallis, is a species of orchid. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurothallis corniculata include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, but further research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits.
